E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that February 26, 2025, is
Student Government Day; and that on March 22, 2025, they are co­hosting a Community Health Fair for
the residents.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, provided an update on the Carson Street Beautification
project.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, announced the cancelation of the street sweeping scheduled for
February 13, 2025, due to anticipated rainfall.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio, reported that she attended the Petersen Automotive Museum to see Michael
Tovar’s car on display.

Mayor De Paula, reported to he attended the Peterson Automotive Museum to see Michael Tovar’s car
on display; and watched the youth game from our Mini Basketball program.

  The City Council reconvened from Closed Session at 7:29 PM.

  Patrick Donegan, City Attorney, stated no reportable action from Closed Session.
